metadata.title: Datadog Beats Earnings Expectations. The Stock Acts as If It Didn’t.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Datadog Beats Earnings Expectations. The Stock Is Acting as If It Didn’t.
Every dog has its day but that wasn’t the case for shares of Datadog on Wednesday. Solid earnings and a guidance rise weren’t enough to keep Wall Street from selling.
